scope: All three original ZIPs, all files remaining after explicit exclusion rules; no source contents extracted or persisted

exclusions.potential_secret_filenames: credentials, secrets, tokens, cookies, sessions delimited by dot, underscore or dash

limitations: Command, event, route, component, scheduled-job and static asset-path declarations are heuristically extracted; dynamic registrations and other frameworks require manual review.
Options are excluded from command names; subcommands are distinguished from root SlashCommandBuilder declarations.
Exact-name target declarations are search candidates, not proof of dispatch, authorization, semantics, persistence, failure behavior or acceptance coverage.
Static declarations can be unused, conditional or incomplete; every behavior still requires source-level semantic traceability.
Generated, dependency, cache, agent state, environment and potential secret/runtime files are excluded explicitly; source files above eight megabytes or non-UTF8 encodings remain unresolved.
